name: shead36
caption:
MORE THAN LOWRY? 🎮🏀 Kyle Lowry has the most assists in our history. Minute for minute, Jamal Shead's career rate with us is higher.

• Assists per 36 minutes with us: Lowry 7.4, Shead 8.4 (#3 in our history, behind T.J. Ford and José Calderón)
• Pick 45 in 2024, traded to us on draft night
• First 10 games this season: 70 assists in 24.2 minutes a night, 10.4 per 36
• 16 assists at Milwaukee, then 20 points and 11 assists in his start vs Memphis

Better passer than Lowry, or not even close? 👇

beats.head: MORE THAN LOWRY?
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: Jamal Shead passes more than Kyle Lowry, minute for minute. And Lowry has more assists than anyone in our history.
beats.dlg: LOWRY: #1 IN ASSISTS.|SHEAD PASSES MORE PER MIN.

beats.head: BY THE MINUTE
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Assists per thirty-six minutes with us: Lowry, seven point four. Shead, eight point four. Only Tee Jay Ford and Jose Calderon rate higher.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: This season, it's even higher. Seventy assists in our first ten games, in about twenty-four minutes a night. That's ten point four per thirty-six.

beats.head: THE START
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: Sixteen assists at Milwaukee. Then, starting against Memphis: twenty points and eleven assists.

beats.head: BETTER THAN LOWRY?
beats.vo: Pick forty-five, passing like an all-timer. Better passer than Lowry, or not even close? Comment below.

facts.claim: Raptors career leaders, assists per 36 minutes: #1 T.J. Ford 9.5, #2 Jose Calderon 9.1, #3 Jamal Shead 8.4, #5 Kyle Lowry 7.4; Lowry #1 in total assists
2024 NBA draft: Shead selected 45th overall by Sacramento, traded to Toronto on draft night
ESPN game log 2026-27: Shead had 70 assists in 242 minutes over Toronto's first 10 games (24.2 minutes a game, 10.4 assists per 36 minutes)
Shead was in Toronto's starting lineup vs Memphis on Nov 9, 2026
